artifacts.summary: Implementation plan v11 with 4 phases to close the sole sorry blocking completeness_discrete via discrete game pipeline

memory_candidates.content: When a sorry chain has a single root sorry that affects only discrete orders, the most effective strategy is to build a discrete-only bypass: (1) verify the discrete game pipeline components are sorry-free, (2) prove discrete interval type heredity (sub-interval bridge hypotheses pass down), (3) compose the pipeline (decomposition_agreement -> game wins -> nf_fraisse_compression -> NF equality), (4) wire the discrete version into the call site replacing the general sorry-tainted version. This avoids needing to fix the general case entirely.
